lines.text: This is it — your capstone project!
You will design and build your very own arcade game.
You can make a catch game, a maze game, a dodge game, or your own idea.
Your game must use everything you have learned: events, loops, if-then rules, a variable, and a win or lose ending.
Here is a skeleton every game can use: reset the score and timer, then keep checking for a win or a game over.
When a friend tests your game, watch without helping.
Ask for two stars and a wish, then improve one thing.
You have learned so much. Now make something amazing, and share it with the world!
